parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA
parsed.notes: This is a preliminary update, not a results release, and it contains no reconciliation table. It gives only an expected range for Q3 2026 (quarter ending 2026-09-30): Adjusted EBITDA of negative $565 million to negative $510 million. That range includes about $625–675 million of charges from commercial actions. FMC says its quarterly results are not finalized, so no actual figures are reported. No prior-year or year-to-date Adjusted EBITDA figures appear in the excerpt.
